new_theorem.statement: If A=D+V K V^T with physical diagonal D, V^T V=I_r, r in {3,4}, K invertible and s3(K)>=gamma, then for every 0<eta<=1 either ||p_Q||inf <= 24 sqrt(2e)/[gamma sqrt(eta(2-eta))] with continuous density and direct linear interval bound, or some unit carrier direction Vu has >1-eta squared mass on at most 64 eta^-2 original coordinates. Proof random-splits only rows of leverage <=eta^2/16 and applies account03/B09 r39 aggregate physical third-volume smoothing.

partner_application.statement: For overlapping two-bank Walsh frames W=diag(P_N,C_N), N>=8, K_epsilon=[[diag(1,0),I2],[I2,diag(1+epsilon,0)]], and any physical diagonal D, a balanced physical cut has Z3=(4+2epsilon+3epsilon^2)/64>=1/16 and row-volume marginals <=4/N<=1/2. Thus account03/B09 r39 gives ||p||inf <=6 sqrt(2e) 2^(2/3)=22.2075246553 uniformly for epsilon>=0, including the rank-four to rank-three limit. At D=0 the spectrum is {1,-1,(2+epsilon +/- sqrt(4+epsilon^2))/2}, so the owner target holds for all epsilon>=0.

required_pinned_application.statement: For one physical hub and Walsh leaf bank with flat orthonormal c,v1,v2, Q=2X_h<c,X_I>+<v1,X_I>^2+<v2,X_I>^2 has target spectrum {1,-1,1,1}. The pinned e5f Theorem H gives |phi(t)|<=8pi^2|t|^-2, hence ||p_Q||inf<=4sqrt2 and P{Q in L}<=4sqrt2|L|, while retaining arbitrary allowed outside blocks and dense same-side leaf curvature.

method_obstruction: A >1-eta coefficient localization certificate does not make the light tail probabilistically small: v=sqrt(1-eta)e1+sqrt(eta)e2 with X2 uniform on [eta^-1/2,eta^-1/2+1] has order-one light contribution. Do not delete the tail or r38 residual by norm smallness.
